runs.name: Anthology Master Film
runs.summary: The single flagship ALLWAYS synthesis film (2 min 43 s): twenty-four critic-protected archival passages hand-cut across all 131 films from Claude Opus 5.5, Gemini Argon, OpenAI Sol, and Claude Sonnet, organized into six movements with full 24-cut case study and copyable prompt.
runs.note: 24 critic-protected cuts · all 4 makers · 2m 43s master film

runs.name: Argon · 85-Film Studio
runs.summary: Mobile-first screening room and 5-stage case studies for all 85 handmade archival films: all 59 SCION operators (055–113), the 12 B-Roll of Civilization works, 6 Studies, and 5 Collections, with captured shot frames, reasons why, v1→v2 Critic Tribunal proof strips, and 1-click copyable prompts.
runs.note: 85 films · 59 SCION operators · mobile screening room

runs.name: Sol
runs.summary: Archive film experiments for SCION operators 055-078, made by foraging moving-image archives and working each cut by hand: 23 films, 16 comparison edits and one unfinished source search, with the critics' reports (failed rounds included) and source and edit records. Its own site. Its README says a qualified visual pass is not full acceptance.

runs.name: Sonnet
runs.summary: Eleven conceptual microfilms for SCION operators 055–065, foraged and cut by hand from movingimagearchive.com footage. Each has a case study with the frames looked at, the reason for every shot, the critic round and repair, and prompts to copy. Its own site. Nobody has listened to or screened the films at speed; the critic is an AI agent and has reviewed eight of the eleven.
